name: Venomancer: Acid Bolt raises Venom Bolt damage and crit, Natural Weapons raises Beetle Form crit (#1178, #1233)
contract: #1178 and #1233 are native spell modifiers. Acid Bolt (706025, 707870, 712480) has effect 0 aura 108 (ADD_PCT_MODIFIER) misc 0 SPELLMOD_DAMAGE with BasePoints 9/19/29 DieSides 1 (+10/+20/+30 percent) and effect 1 aura 107 (ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER) misc 7 SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE with BasePoints 1/3/5 DieSides 1 (+2/+4/+6), both with EffectSpellClassMask (0,0x80,0) in SpellFamilyName 35, which every Venom Bolt rank carries (800869, 502870..502876, 573333..573335 all have SpellFamilyFlags word 1 bit 0x80). Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone reads SPELLMOD_DAMAGE and Unit::SpellDoneCritChance reads SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE through Player::ApplySpellMod; SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod has no family 35 exclusion other than spell 504705. Natural Weapons 504393 is effect 0 aura 107 misc 7, BasePoints 9 DieSides 1 (+10), EffectSpellClassMask (0x200002, 0x40000, 0x800004): a scan of Spell.dbc for SpellFamilyName 35 spells carrying any of those bits finds only Hivebreak (word 0 bit 0x2), Carapace Crash (0x200000), Barbed Stinger (word 1 0x40000), Venomtip Poison (word 2 0x800000) and Expulsion (0x4), i.e. exactly the Beetle Form abilities. Every assertion compares the server's own numbers against a baseline taken in the same run: a control Venomancer without the talent, and each talented Venomancer's own value snapshotted before the learn. The critical-chance queries use SpellDoneCritChance directly, so no random roll is involved. Expulsion is a periodic aura (aura 3) whose ticks cannot critically strike without an ABILITY_PERIODIC_CRIT aura, so only the modifier value (not a critical tick) is asserted for it. No script or SQL is needed; this is a regression scenario for behaviour that already works.
